extracted.intended_audience: agency PRA officers and members of the public commenting on information collection requests
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and content elements for Federal Register notices announcing submission of information collection requests to OMB under the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA), and related instructions for public comment and access. Applies to agency notices (here, Department of the Treasury / Bureau of the Fiscal Service).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments close / deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments should be received on or before September 2, 2025 to be assured of consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notice must state a clear deadline for public comments and advise that timely receipt is necessary for consideration. If comments are no longer being accepted, the notice should direct readers to the DATES section for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addresses for submission of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Written comments and recommendations for the proposed information collection should be sent within 30 days of publication of this notice to www.reginfo.gov/public/do/PRAMain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a URL or method for submitting comments (Reginfo.gov PRA submission page). Include instructions for finding the specific collection (e.g., select 'Currently under 30-day Review—Open for Public Comments' or use the search function).

rubrics_metrics.name: FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT (PRA contact)
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies of the submissions may be obtained from Melody Braswell by emailing PRA@treasury.gov, calling (202) 622-1035, or viewing the entire information collection request at www.reginfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a named contact (PRA Clearance Officer or equivalent) with email, phone, and where to view the full submission online so interested parties can obtain supporting materials and ask questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title (of the information collection)
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. Title: Trace Request for Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Payment; and Trace Request Direct Deposit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each collection must be titled clearly so the public can identify the purpose of the forms/collection. Titles should appear in the Supplementary Information where collections are enumerated.

rubrics_metrics.name: OMB Number
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the OMB control number assigned to the information collection (or indicate if pending). This lets stakeholders reference the approved clearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form Number
rubrics_metrics.description: Form Number: FS Form 150.1 and FS Form 150.2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the specific agency form numbers associated with the collection so respondents and reviewers can identify the instrument(s) involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract (purpose and use of the collection/forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract: These forms are used to notify the financial organization that a customer (beneficiary) has claimed non-receipt of credit for a payment. The forms are designed to help the financial organization locate any problems and to keep the customer (beneficiary) informed of any action taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise description of the information collected and its intended use. Explain why the information is necessary and how it supports program operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Current Actions: Extension of a currently approved collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify whether the submission is for a new collection, a revision, an extension, or discontinuance. This status informs reviewers about whether burdens or content are changing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of Review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate the type of OMB review (e.g., regular, emergency, reinstatement) to clarify the review process and timeline expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affected Public
rubrics_metrics.description: Affected Public: Business or other for-profit. (Other collections list Individuals and estates, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify classes of respondents (e.g., individuals, households, businesses, State/local governments) and, where appropriate, note if the majority or a small percentage belong to particular categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated Number of Respondents
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated Number of Respondents: 26,895. (Examples for other collections: 114; 2200; 25,350.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an estimate of how many respondents will be subject to the collection annually. Break out by form/collection when multiple collections are in one notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated Time per Respondent
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated Time per Respondent: 8 minutes. (Other examples: 30 minutes; 6 minutes; 30 minutes.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Estimate the average time burden for an individual respondent to complete the form or respond. Use realistic assumptions and, where appropriate, provide ranges for different respondent types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated Total Annual Burden Hours
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated Total Annual Burden Hours: 30,466. (Other examples: 57; 220; 12,675.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate and present the aggregate annual burden hours (estimated respondents × estimated time). Include totals for each collection and overall totals for notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority citation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite the statutory authority under which the PRA notice is issued. Include relevant U.S.C. citations to support the agency's action and legal basis for collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document headings and required metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Headings: document headings vary by document type but may contain the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal Register notices should include standard headings/metadata (agency, action, CFR parts, docket number, RIN) so the action is citable, searchable, and tied to regulatory tracking systems. Consult the Document Drafting Handbook for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide official PDF / public inspection and verification guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format. Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507. If you are using public inspection listings for legal research, you should verify the contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a link to the official PDF (govinfo.gov) and an explicit statement that the XML/online rendition is informational only until the official edition is issued. Advise readers to verify against the official edition for legal research.
